Outsider (Lawful, Evil) · SM -3 Imp [Monster Manual, page 56]

A wiry rust-red creature the size of a cat, with small leathery wings, swept-back brow horns and a thin tail ending in a sting. It prefers another shape in company, whispers bad advice with real fluency, and is far harder to be rid of than its size suggests.
